priority_scale.P0: release-blocking data corruption or architecture failure
priority_scale.P3: bounded defect, security low, or important hardening

findings.title: Canonical event contracts are neither centralized nor enforced
findings.violated_invariant: Every internal event kind has one declared producer contract, legal context combination, host-direction meaning, state effect, lifecycle role, and consumer set.
findings.owning_layer: canonical event model and dispatcher boundary

exact_evidence.static: SecurityEvent requires only timestamp and a free-form event_type across 55 fields; event legality is distributed through constructors and emitter can_handle methods.
exact_evidence.dynamic: A context-free SecurityEvent(event_type='connection') dispatches successfully, receives an event ID, and renders no evidence. Reproduction is recorded in architecture-object-model.md.

findings.recurrence: Systemic: 66 discovered internal names, 68 constructors, 38 mutable contexts, and 23 emitter registrations require reverse-engineered joins.
findings.reproduction: Run the missing-canonical-event-contract probe in architecture-object-model.md.
findings.sibling_risk: Silent drops, illegal host direction, unsupported context combinations, unreviewed future event strings, and incompatible alternate constructors.
findings.proposed_remediation: Approve and introduce EventKindContract plus a sealed occurrence builder; make dispatch reject incomplete or unknown canonical events.
required_tests: table-driven contract test for every event kind
negative tests for every missing/forbidden context
inventory test proving producer and consumer closure

findings.title: Source-observation time mutates canonical lifecycle state
findings.violated_invariant: Canonical state changes only at canonical occurrence time; observation delay and host clock projection never feed back into world state.
findings.owning_layer: dispatcher, observation, source timing, and StateManager

exact_evidence.static: Dispatcher commits canonical state, derives per-source timestamps, then calls update_process_activity_time with a delayed per-emitter event copy.
exact_evidence.test_contract: tests/unit/test_dispatcher.py::TestObservationProfiles::test_delayed_process_source_observation_extends_process_activity explicitly expects a 900,000 ms source delay to extend RunningProcess.last_activity_time.

findings.recurrence: Systemic for process evidence admitted to delayed endpoint sources.
findings.reproduction: Run the named dispatcher unit test and inspect the state timestamp after dispatch.
findings.sibling_risk: Artificial lifetime extension, PID reuse suppression, action attribution after canonical termination, and format-dependent state.
findings.proposed_remediation: Adopt explicit CanonicalTime and ObservedTime types and prohibit observation code from issuing state commands.
required_tests: process reuse invariance under source delay

findings.title: Mutable compatibility contexts coexist with immutable canonical plans
findings.violated_invariant: A shared fact has one authoritative immutable owner after finalization.

exact_evidence.static: All 38 occurrence contexts are mutable; duplicate representations include ids/ids_alerts, file_transfer/file_transfers, x509/x509_chain, mutable NetworkContext plus NetworkTransactionPlan, and EdrContext plus EventIdentityPlan. Sysmon recomputes destination hostname and constructs a synthetic process_create event for timing.
exact_evidence.coverage: The census classifies windows_event_sysmon as an incompatible projection bypass.

findings.recurrence: Cross-cutting; only NetworkContext and EdrContext provide partial plan-versus-compatibility validation.
findings.reproduction: Inspect the duplicate fields in event-context-paths.json and Sysmon projection paths in event-context-path-census.md.
findings.sibling_risk: Per-source hostname, identity, accounting, timing, or certificate drift after shallow event copies.
findings.proposed_remediation: Use private mutable builders followed by one freeze/seal step; remove renderer access to mutable compatibility truth after sealing.

findings.title: Action bundles route calls but often do not own lifecycle construction
findings.violated_invariant: Each real-world action family has one bundle owner shared by storyline, baseline, red-herring, startup, and causal callers.

exact_evidence.static: Thirty-three anchored bundles immediately delegate to legacy _execute_* methods. ActivityGenerator is 22,407 lines; BaselineMixin is 8,409; StorylineMixin is 5,456; _execute_typed_event is 2,846.
exact_evidence.census: Process termination retains separate user and system owners; process/file/image paths also have direct alternate constructors.

findings.recurrence: Systemic across process, auth, DNS, DHCP, Kerberos, Windows audit, scanner, and email families.
findings.reproduction: Use generator_methods and action_bundles rows in event-context-paths.json.
findings.sibling_risk: New entry paths bypass lifecycle, timing, identity, or observation rules while appearing architecturally compliant.
findings.proposed_remediation: Extract vertical slices in dependency order and make legacy generator methods private adapters into bundle-owned planners.
required_tests: bundle owns every emitted occurrence role
no direct stateful constructor outside owner

findings.title: Timing constraints are distributed and order-sensitive
findings.violated_invariant: One action graph resolves canonical occurrence constraints before observation and source-native timing projection.

exact_evidence.static: Timing is split among bundle constraint graphs, generator clamps, state registries, dispatcher special cases, source timing, and renderer-local calculations.
exact_evidence.rendered: Integrated output has two source-side RDP FLOW records after target authentication and 21 Zeek file intervals ending 1-2 ms beyond the parent connection.

findings.recurrence: Multiple independent families in one integrated run.
findings.reproduction: Run realism_review_probe.py against branch-enterprise and inspect ecar_rdp_transport_before_auth and zeek_file_interval.
findings.sibling_risk: Transport/auth inversion, orphaned lifecycle evidence, closure outside collection windows, and source-specific impossible sequences.
findings.proposed_remediation: Approve an ActionTimeline contract with typed nodes/edges, then derive every source time from its frozen solution.
required_tests: all source times derived from sealed timeline

findings.title: Causal expansion uses string callbacks and fails open
findings.violated_invariant: Required causal evidence is typed, validated, and either produced or generation fails explicitly.

exact_evidence.static: Rules resolve executor method names as strings and catch expansion exceptions.
exact_evidence.dynamic: A matching rule whose expand raises RuntimeError logs a traceback and returns [], allowing the triggering path to continue.

findings.recurrence: All automatic causal rules share the engine behavior.
findings.reproduction: Run the fail-open causal-expansion probe in architecture-object-model.md.
findings.sibling_risk: Silent missing prerequisites, partial narratives, non-reproducible evaluator failures, and renaming drift.
findings.proposed_remediation: Replace method-name callbacks with typed bundle requests and classify causal rules as required or best-effort with explicit result status.
required_tests: static type closure for every rule request

findings.title: Occurrence identity and ground truth are parallel, sequence-sensitive models
findings.violated_invariant: Evidence occurrence IDs derive from stable action identity and role, and ground truth is projected from the same action graph.

exact_evidence.dynamic: Inserting one unrelated earlier event changes the target event ID at the same type and timestamp.
exact_evidence.static: Storyline/red-herring dictionaries, observation registry, and emitter summaries are reconciled imperatively into ground truth rather than projected from action occurrences.

findings.recurrence: Global event sequence affects every occurrence ID; ground-truth assembly spans all storyline families.
findings.reproduction: Run the sequence-sensitive event identity probe in architecture-object-model.md.
findings.sibling_risk: Unrelated feature changes invalidate joins, golden fixtures, truth references, and evaluation baselines.
findings.proposed_remediation: Adopt ActionId plus OccurrenceRole-derived IDs and make truth/observation ledgers projections of the sealed action graph.

findings.title: Architecture documentation and registered surfaces overstate reachability and ownership
findings.violated_invariant: Documented event, format, and bundle contracts are generated and tested through production paths.

exact_evidence.census: module_load and special_privileges are emitter-supported without production producers; WeirdContext has no production constructor; EmailContext has no emitter/evaluator consumer; three bundles lack ActionAnchor and three lack direct tests.
exact_evidence.coverage: coverage-summary.json lists every unresolved inventory item explicitly.

findings.recurrence: Six context/format/bundle gaps plus stale architecture completion language.
findings.reproduction: Run realism_review_inventory.py and inspect unresolved_static_inventory.
findings.sibling_risk: Users enable formats that never emit, reviewers assume owners that are adapters, and new code copies stale patterns.
findings.proposed_remediation: After contracts are approved, remove dead registrations or add real producers and update architecture status to measured conformance.

findings.title: Connection-owner processes are reused across ended or different logon sessions
findings.violated_invariant: A process belongs to exactly one live session, and one-shot SSH client processes do not own overlapping independent sessions.

exact_evidence.static: Both reuse filters match username/image/command/time but never require proc.logon_id == selected session.logon_id.
exact_evidence.rendered: The integrated probe finds five ssh.exe actors owning overlapping TCP/22 intervals and three processes producing or terminating after their owning LogonID logged out.

findings.recurrence: All four blind reviewers emphasized lifecycle realism; historical session-closure reports show the same family.
findings.reproduction: Run realism_review_probe.py and inspect ecar_ssh_actor_overlapping_connections and ecar_process_after_session_logout.
findings.sibling_risk: Browser/proxy reuse, scp/sftp clients, remote admin tools, stale parentage, and PID retention across interactive logons.
findings.proposed_remediation: Make ProcessIdentity carry immutable SessionIdentity and require session match for reuse; create one-shot SSH clients per transport unless multiplexing is explicit.
required_tests: SSH overlap only with explicit multiplexing

findings.title: One LogonID can change from zero to nonzero LogonGuid
findings.violated_invariant: LogonID-to-LogonGuid identity is immutable for a session.

exact_evidence.static: get_or_create_session_logon_guid may return zero when nonzero is not required; a later auth package can persist a nonzero GUID for the same session.
exact_evidence.rendered: Two LogonIDs in WS-NKAPOOR Sysmon rows each have both all-zero and nonzero GUID values.

findings.recurrence: Two current sessions; blind Detection and Host/EDR reviews independently found it.
findings.reproduction: Run the probe and inspect sysmon_logon_guid_immutable.
findings.sibling_risk: Token, session, ProcessGuid, and ground-truth joins can split one session into multiple identities.
findings.proposed_remediation: Allocate final SessionIdentity, including GUID nullability, before the first dependent occurrence and prohibit later metadata replacement.
required_tests: GUID immutability for every auth-package order

findings.title: Distinct failed login attempts can share one eCAR objectID
findings.violated_invariant: Each authentication attempt is a distinct occurrence even when principal, source, port, host, and timestamp coincide.

exact_evidence.static: Failed-session object identity derives from host, user, exact time, source IP, and port without an attempt ordinal/action role.
exact_evidence.empirical: The expanded ten-run matrix finds duplicate failed-attempt identities in nine of ten runs; branch-enterprise has one duplicate group.

findings.recurrence: Current multi-run recurrence and historical session-closure recurrence.
findings.reproduction: Run the probe on the ten branch-24h outputs and inspect ecar_failed_attempt_identity_unique.
findings.sibling_risk: Same-millisecond process/file/network events and retry loops may collapse if identity inputs omit occurrence role/ordinal.
findings.proposed_remediation: Derive occurrence identity from ActionId, explicit attempt ordinal, and occurrence role.

findings.title: Linux local-session process ancestry reverses login and user-manager roles
findings.violated_invariant: System login/session machinery precedes per-user systemd and the interactive shell in a source-native process tree.

exact_evidence.static: _ensure_linux_local_session_shell_parent creates systemd --user under PID 1, then creates /bin/login as its child.
exact_evidence.rendered: The probe finds /bin/login parented by /usr/lib/systemd/systemd in the proxy host stream.

findings.recurrence: Validated by Host/EDR blind review and current probe.
findings.reproduction: Inspect ecar_linux_login_parentage in probe-branch-enterprise.json.
findings.sibling_risk: Gnome terminal, sshd/PAM, sudo, su, tmux/screen, and shell-history ownership.
findings.proposed_remediation: Make LinuxLocalSessionActionBundle own an OS-specific bootstrap graph with explicit parent roles.

findings.title: IDS signature claims can contradict their parent connection and HTTP evidence
findings.violated_invariant: An attached IDS signature is semantically possible for the canonical payload direction, response state, protocol, and inspection visibility.
findings.owning_layer: IDS attachment policy on the network action

exact_evidence.static: The signature is selected and IdsContext is built before the inbound connection profile independently selects state/accounting. Filtering only looks for the word 'response', so 'GPL WEB_SERVER 403 Forbidden' survives.
exact_evidence.rendered: SID 2101411 claims 403 Forbidden for 185.199.110.42:53211 -> 10.44.30.10:80; joined Zeek is S0 with one SYN and zero response packets/bytes, and ASA tears down with SYN Timeout and zero bytes.

findings.recurrence: Three blind reviewers found this family; one decisive current tuple is fully cross-source proven.
findings.reproduction: Run the probe and inspect ids_transport_semantics; join the recorded tuple across snort_alert.log, conn.json, and cisco_asa.log.
findings.sibling_risk: Status-code, exploit-success, server-response, TLS-decryption, DNS-answer, and file-content signatures.
findings.proposed_remediation: Represent signature preconditions as structured direction/phase/payload/inspection predicates evaluated after the network outcome is planned.

findings.title: Source-side RDP FLOW can render after successful target authentication
findings.violated_invariant: Source-visible transport precedes successful remote authentication for the same tuple.
findings.owning_layer: RDP action timeline and endpoint source timing

exact_evidence.static: The bundle derives logon_time from request/canonical transport intent, but source eCAR FLOW timing is admitted later without a constraint to actual rendered endpoint transport time.
exact_evidence.rendered: The probe finds two outbound RDP FLOW records 1.2-1.7 seconds after the matching target USER_SESSION LOGIN.

findings.recurrence: Two integrated RDP sessions; independently identified by Detection and Host/EDR reviewers.
findings.reproduction: Inspect ecar_rdp_transport_before_auth in probe-branch-enterprise.json.
findings.sibling_risk: SSH, remote service, explicit credentials, Kerberos preauth, and source-process visibility ordering.
findings.proposed_remediation: Bind auth readiness to the final admitted endpoint-flow time or omit actor identity when process visibility cannot fit before auth.
required_tests: source FLOW < target auth across profiles

findings.title: Zeek file observations can end outside their parent connection interval
findings.violated_invariant: A file observation joined by conn_uid is contained in that sensor's visible connection interval.

exact_evidence.static: File projection independently derives a Zeek connection start/anchor rather than consuming one frozen sensor interval.
exact_evidence.rendered: Twenty-one integrated files end 1-2 ms after the joined conn end.

findings.recurrence: 21 rows across multiple transfer/protocol families.
findings.reproduction: Run the probe and inspect zeek_file_interval.
findings.sibling_risk: X.509/OCSP/PE child records, SMTP attachments, HTTP request/response timing, and collection-window tails.
findings.proposed_remediation: Put the final source-visible sensor interval in NetworkSensorObservation and require child analyzers to consume it.
required_tests: file interval contained for every source

findings.title: Small worlds can collapse DHCP client, server, and assigned-IP roles
findings.violated_invariant: Infrastructure roles and endpoint leases are distinct unless an explicit topology models otherwise.
findings.owning_layer: WorldModel infrastructure resolution and DHCP lease bundle

exact_evidence.static: Infrastructure fallbacks can choose 10.0.0.1 for DNS/DC/DHCP semantics even when that is the only modeled endpoint address.
exact_evidence.rendered: The minimal probe finds two DHCP role errors and two self-connections; the 30-day run repeats each defect 1,442 times.

findings.recurrence: Deterministic on the minimal fixture and scales linearly over 30 days.
findings.reproduction: Run the probe on minimal and minimal-30d outputs.
findings.sibling_risk: DNS, NTP, DC, gateway, NAT, and hostile-scanner pool role collisions.
findings.proposed_remediation: Compile required infrastructure capabilities explicitly and fail validation or synthesize distinct reserved infrastructure identities before baseline generation.

findings.title: Format filtering changes canonical generation rather than only projection
findings.violated_invariant: Identical scenario intent produces the same canonical world/action graph regardless of selected output projections.
findings.owning_layer: CLI, emitter setup, baseline scheduling, dispatcher/state

source_families: all; proven on all nine Zeek files

exact_evidence.static: CLI mutates scenario.output.logs; emitter setup consumes it; baseline gates generation families on enabled emitters; dispatcher state updates occur per admitted emitter.
exact_evidence.empirical: Every one of nine Zeek files differs between full-output and Zeek-only generation of the same 24-hour scenario.

findings.recurrence: All compared Zeek projections differ materially.
findings.reproduction: Use format_filter_equivalence commands and hashes in empirical-results.json.
findings.sibling_risk: Ground truth, RNG consumption, state lifetimes, evaluator scores, and parallel-output equivalence.
findings.proposed_remediation: Plan canonical actions independently of emitters; apply output selection only after observation/source projection.

findings.title: Automated evaluation accepts datasets with material scenario and correlation failures
findings.violated_invariant: Acceptance requires all declared indicators, causal pivots, temporal contracts, and high-impact cross-source invariants.

exact_evidence.empirical: The adapted APT dataset scores 93.4466 and passes despite 20 indicator mismatches, 31/36 pivots, 24/26 temporal checks, and 26/32 storyline traces. Branch enterprise scores 96.1891 and passes despite nine indicator mismatches, 2/5 pivots, and 46 expanded-probe findings.
exact_evidence.analysis: Several dimensions award vacuous 100 scores when evidence is absent and only selected hard gates affect acceptance.

findings.recurrence: Both large integrated scenarios pass while expert review rejects the data as synthetic.
findings.reproduction: Run the evaluation commands in empirical-results.json, then compare with probe and blind-summary.md.
findings.sibling_risk: Regression loops optimize to an insensitive score and declare family completion while expert-rejection defects persist.
findings.proposed_remediation: Add invariant-based hard gates, non-vacuous coverage denominators, scenario completeness thresholds, and independent bad fixtures.

findings.title: Windows Security Event 4648 uses non-native network field names
findings.violated_invariant: Source-native projection uses the provider's declared field names and nullability.
findings.owning_layer: Windows Security format definition and emitter

exact_evidence.reference: Microsoft Event 4648 documentation uses IpAddress and IpPort.
exact_evidence.rendered: All seven Windows host files containing 4648 use NetworkAddress and NetworkPort; the probe reports the per-host counts.

findings.recurrence: Every current 4648 record; every blind reviewer with Windows focus noted source fidelity concerns.
findings.reproduction: Run the probe and inspect windows_4648_native_fields; compare source-references.json.
findings.sibling_risk: Other hand-maintained Windows event schemas, provider version metadata, and downstream parser mappings.
findings.proposed_remediation: Correct the format/emitter together and add official-manifest field snapshots for every supported Windows Event ID.
required_tests: all Windows event schemas against reference ledger

findings.title: Several source-visible distributions expose fixed or independently sampled fingerprints
findings.violated_invariant: Durations, retry schedules, device identity, and normal workload cadence are stateful and entity-scoped rather than fixed or independently uniform.

exact_evidence.rendered: All 36 OCSP response files last exactly 0.02 seconds; all AAAA queries in the integrated sensor succeed; IRQ and device placeholders are sampled independently; GPO refresh repeatedly forces /target:computer /force; DHCP T1 is independently resampled at every renewal.
exact_evidence.blind: The four reviewers independently identified multiple members of this texture family.

findings.recurrence: Dataset-wide or schedule-wide, not isolated rows.
findings.reproduction: Inspect zeek_ocsp_duration_distribution and zeek_aaaa_success_distribution plus the cited config/baseline paths.
findings.sibling_risk: TLS optionality, public-client personas, service churn, cron schedules, and exact-hour activity.
findings.proposed_remediation: Move each enumerable to validated data and each recurring behavior to durable per-entity state with coherent jitter and failure probability.

findings.title: Scenario loading silently accepts duplicate YAML keys and a flagship coverage fixture is invalid
findings.violated_invariant: Authored intent is unambiguous and all shipped fixtures validate at the frozen baseline.
findings.owning_layer: YAML loader, validation, and fixture maintenance

exact_evidence.static: yaml.safe_load uses last-key-wins behavior and does not reject mapping duplicates.
exact_evidence.empirical: full-coverage-apt.yaml has duplicate command_line and fails validation because all three network segments lack required exposure. The empirical campaign required a temporary exposure-only adaptation.

findings.recurrence: One shipped full-coverage fixture plus any authored duplicate key.
findings.reproduction: Run eforge validate on tests/fixtures/scenarios/full-coverage-apt.yaml and inspect the duplicate command_line mapping.
findings.sibling_risk: Security-relevant intent, output filters, identity fields, and overlay keys can silently change.
findings.proposed_remediation: Use a duplicate-rejecting safe YAML loader at every scenario/config boundary and validate all shipped fixtures in CI.

findings.title: The requested seed matrix cannot be expressed through the public generation contract
findings.violated_invariant: A documented generation seed controls every stochastic substream while preserving deterministic replay.

exact_evidence.static: GenerationEngine resets its thread-local RNG to 42; no coherent public seed is exposed by scenario or CLI.
exact_evidence.empirical: The ten-run matrix had to vary scenario names, affecting only stable scenario-keyed substreams while the global stream remained fixed. Identical input repeat was byte-identical.

findings.recurrence: Global generation property.
findings.reproduction: Review integrated_24h_matrix and repeat hashes in empirical-results.json.
findings.sibling_risk: Misleading benchmarks, limited variance testing, global-stream coupling, and accidental sequence shifts.
findings.proposed_remediation: Approve a GenerationSeed contract with named hierarchical RNG scopes and record it in manifests.
required_tests: unrelated family insertion does not perturb other scopes

findings.title: Interactive Windows Explorer can be directly parented by services.exe
findings.violated_invariant: Interactive shell ancestry reflects a user logon bootstrap rather than the service control manager.

exact_evidence.rendered: The integrated probe finds explorer.exe directly parented by services.exe; the blind Host/EDR review independently identifies the same ancestry defect.
exact_evidence.static: Parent repair/fallback logic can choose available system roots without a typed process-role constraint.

findings.recurrence: One integrated host occurrence; sibling fallback paths are broad.
findings.reproduction: Inspect ecar_explorer_parentage in probe-branch-enterprise.json.
findings.sibling_risk: Userinit/winlogon, service-launched UI, scheduled tasks, and parent-chain repair.
findings.proposed_remediation: Add typed process roles and allowed parent-role edges to the process execution contract.

findings.title: Email artifact IDs escape the output tree for arbitrary .eml writes
findings.violated_invariant: Scenario-controlled artifact names cannot escape the selected output root.

exact_evidence.dynamic: A probe wrote /private/tmp/eforge-review-artifact-escape-20260805.eml before relative_to raised.
exact_evidence.control: The .eml suffix and OS permissions constrain impact; containment is checked only after the write.

findings.recurrence: Every materialized attacker-controlled artifact_id.
findings.reproduction: Use an artifact_id with parent traversal or an absolute path and enable storyline artifacts.
findings.sibling_risk: Other artifact IDs, manifest paths, and target transformation outputs.
findings.proposed_remediation: Validate opaque IDs and open only beneath a resolved symlink-safe artifact root.

findings.title: Scenario duration and periodic cardinality permit compact resource-exhaustion inputs
findings.violated_invariant: Validation bounds projected generation work before execution.

exact_evidence.dynamic: Models accept duration=999999999999d, interval=1ms, and count=10^12.
exact_evidence.static: Loops expand these values without a global projected-event/byte budget.

findings.recurrence: All duration/rate/count-driven families.
findings.reproduction: Construct the extreme values in the corresponding Pydantic models; do not execute the full workload.
findings.sibling_risk: Baseline windows, beacons, DNS tunnels, sprays, scans, output disk growth, and datetime overflow.
findings.proposed_remediation: Add preflight workload budgets with an explicit operator override.

findings.title: Email attachment size drives eager allocation and MIME amplification
findings.violated_invariant: Small authored input cannot request unbounded memory, CPU, or disk allocation.

exact_evidence.dynamic: The model accepts 10^12 bytes; bounded probes allocate exact 1, 4, and 16 MiB payloads.
exact_evidence.static: OOXML generation repeatedly sums chunks and MIME base64 creates additional copies.

findings.recurrence: Each materialized attachment and cumulative message set.
findings.reproduction: Call _email_attachment_payload_bytes with bounded sizes; model-validate an extreme size without allocating it.
findings.sibling_risk: Literal content, corpus bodies, artifact manifest size, and multiple attachments.
findings.proposed_remediation: Enforce per-attachment/per-message/run budgets and stream encoding.

findings.title: Port-scan target resolution materializes every host before applying target_count
findings.violated_invariant: Work is O(requested targets), not O(address-space size).

exact_evidence.static: [str(h) for h in net.hosts()] runs before min(target_count, len(all_hosts)).
exact_evidence.dynamic: Pydantic accepts an IPv6 /64 with target_count=1; catastrophic enumeration was not executed.

findings.recurrence: Any unmodeled large segment.
findings.reproduction: Model-validate an IPv6 /64 target; inspect the eager list comprehension.
findings.sibling_risk: Other CIDR enumeration, asset expansion, and evaluator address sets.
findings.proposed_remediation: Sample integer host offsets without full enumeration and bound supported prefix sizes.

findings.title: Acyclic scenario include graphs have no depth, file, byte, or node budget
findings.violated_invariant: Include expansion is cycle-safe and resource-bounded before schema validation.

exact_evidence.static: Active-stack cycle detection exists, but unique paths recurse, parse, and deepcopy without aggregate limits.

findings.recurrence: Any deep or wide multi-file scenario package.
findings.reproduction: Construct a bounded acyclic include chain/fan-out and observe recursive work; avoid host-impacting sizes.
findings.sibling_risk: Corpus/config recursive loading and large YAML node graphs.
findings.proposed_remediation: Track and enforce depth, file count, aggregate source bytes, and expanded node count.

findings.title: Snare expanded-field parsing is quadratic on delimiter-free input
findings.violated_invariant: Evaluator parsing is linear and record-size bounded for hostile logs.

exact_evidence.static: A non-greedy wildcard plus repeated lookahead is applied with finditer and no line cap.

findings.recurrence: Per crafted record; multiple rows multiply impact.
findings.reproduction: Benchmark EXPANDED_FIELD_PATTERN.finditer over delimiter-free field-like tails.
findings.sibling_risk: Other regex parsers and unlimited record lengths.
findings.proposed_remediation: Use a linear delimiter parser and reject/clip oversized records with explicit diagnostics.

findings.title: Email corpus paths read YAML outside the documented scenario root
findings.violated_invariant: Scenario-referenced corpus reads remain inside an explicit project root.

exact_evidence.dynamic: An absolute YAML path outside the scenario directory was read and returned 12 corpus IDs with zero validation issues.
exact_evidence.constraint: The file must be readable and corpus-shaped; arbitrary bytes are not exposed verbatim.

findings.recurrence: Validation and runtime both follow the path.
findings.reproduction: Set corpus to an absolute out-of-root valid corpus YAML and validate.
findings.sibling_risk: Other referenced scenario files, corpora, templates, and symlink targets.
findings.proposed_remediation: Resolve against a declared scenario-package root, reject escapes/symlinks/nonregular files, and enforce size/schema budgets.

findings.title: Splunk log staging follows supported-name symlinks outside source_root
findings.violated_invariant: External parser staging reads only regular files resolved beneath its selected data root.

exact_evidence.dynamic: A supported-name symlink staged bytes from /private/tmp/eforge-review-splunk-secret.json outside source_root.
exact_evidence.static: relative_to checks the symlink pathname, then shutil.copyfile dereferences it.

findings.recurrence: Every supported filename discovered via rglob.
findings.reproduction: Place a supported-name symlink below source_root and call stage_splunk_logs.
findings.sibling_risk: Special files such as /dev/zero, unsupported record counting, and race swaps.
findings.proposed_remediation: lstat and reject symlinks/nonregular files; verify every resolved path remains under source_root.

findings.title: Splunk app archives have traversal checks but no extraction quotas
findings.violated_invariant: Third-party archive extraction is path-safe and resource-bounded.

exact_evidence.static: ZIP checks paths then calls extractall; TAR streams all regular members. Neither enforces member count, expanded bytes, per-member size, nesting, or ratio.

findings.recurrence: Every supplied ZIP/TAR app.
findings.reproduction: Inspect archive metadata for a bounded compressed fixture; no destructive bomb extraction is required.
findings.sibling_risk: Disk fill, inode exhaustion, long extraction, and retained temp trees on interruption.
findings.proposed_remediation: Preflight and stream-count member/byte/ratio budgets with cleanup on every failure.

findings.title: Splunk app-directory staging dereferences embedded symlinks
findings.violated_invariant: Supplied app staging remains within the selected app directory tree.

exact_evidence.static: shutil.copytree(source, destination, symlinks=False) dereferences descendant symlinks; no prewalk containment check exists.

findings.recurrence: Every descendant symlink in a supplied app directory.
findings.reproduction: Supply a bounded app tree containing a symlink to a benign out-of-root canary.
findings.sibling_risk: Local file inclusion into runtime, special-file reads, and mounted container exposure.
findings.proposed_remediation: Reject descendant symlinks and verify resolved regular-file containment before copying.

findings.title: Evaluator retains a full unbounded parsed corpus without a measured capacity envelope
findings.violated_invariant: Hostile evaluation inputs are processed within documented byte/record/memory limits.

exact_evidence.static: ParsedRecord lists are accumulated and sorted per format, then passed to pillars that build more indexes.
exact_evidence.proof_gap: No controlled records/bytes-to-peak-RSS curve or documented supported limit was completed.

findings.recurrence: Global evaluation behavior.
